name: Sister Application!
original_name: 妹アプリケーション！　- Sister Application !
source:
The ero comedy of an imouto cursed to live inside a smartphone! What is this!? 
In order to free her from her app prison, big brother has to find a lover!! 
He finds a candidate, but she turns out to be---an alien princess!? 
Oh dear, what are brother and sister to do? 

The hymen popping hilarious ADV from 3 on 10!! 

* Ironically, this game is not compatible with smartphones.
translation:
被诅咒住在智能手机里的妹子的色情喜剧！这是什么！？
为了将她从应用程序监狱中解救出来，哥哥必须找到一个爱人！！
他找到了一个候选人，但她竟然是——一位外星公主！？
哦，亲爱的，兄弟姐妹该怎么办？

处女膜爆开搞笑ADV从3到10！

* 讽刺的是，这个游戏不兼容智能手机。
